## Session Context (Alexa MCP)

You can issue verbal commands to Alexa devices and hear her responses via TTS/STT.

**Before starting work:**
1. Try a command: interact(command="what time is it?", wait_for_response=true)
2. Check current status: docs_help()

**At end of work:**
- If you issued important commands, note the response in your session notes
